column2: Waffen SS Campaign Version 2.0
column3: 武装党卫军战役 2.0 版

column2: This version fixes all the bugs .  I haven't found any bugs that prevent a Brilliant Victory in any of the scenarios.  I have also removed one SS division from the start of the game, lowered the prestige allocations for the German player, and added several leaders to the 1st and 2nd SS PanzerDivisions at the start of the game.  These leaders and attributes are assigned randomly (and differently) each time a new campaign is started.
column3: 本版本修复了所有 bug。  我在任何场景中都没有发现会导致无法取得辉煌胜利的 bug。  我还从游戏开始时移除了一个党卫军师，降低了德军玩家的威望分配，并在游戏开始时为第 1 和第 2 党卫军装甲师添加了若干指挥官。  每次开始新战役时，这些指挥官和属性都是随机（且各不相同）分配的。

column2: This campaign is based solely on the combat units of the Waffen SS.  I do not wish to offend in any way, shape, or form anyone who was victimzed by the non-combat elements of the SS during the Second World War.
column3: 本战役完全以武装党卫军的战斗单位为基础。  我无意以任何方式、任何形式冒犯任何在第二次世界大战期间受到党卫军非战斗部门伤害的人。

column2: I would like to thank Ray Schroder and Jay Poling for providing invaluable assistance towards the creation of this campaign.  Also, the equipment table used in this campaign was obtained from Ray's website.
column3: 我要感谢 Ray Schroder 和 Jay Poling 为本战役的创作提供了极其宝贵的帮助。  另外，本战役所用的装备表取自 Ray 的网站。

column2: Note:  these scenarios are not designed to be played individually, at least not in this version (1.1).
column3: 注意：这些场景并非设计为单独游玩，至少在本版本（1.1）中不是这样。

column2: These two files (Equip97.eqp and Equip97.txt) must be used to play the campaign.  They are Ray Schroder's newest equipment table with 3 new units I added for this campaign.  The other files will add numerous text files which are needed and also 24 new scenarios, which use the same maps but have been changed into different theaters of WWII.
column3: 游玩本战役必须使用这两个文件（Equip97.eqp 和 Equip97.txt）。  它们是 Ray Schroder 最新的装备表，其中包含我为本战役添加的 3 个新单位。  其余文件将添加大量必需的文本文件，还有 24 个新场景，这些场景使用相同的地图，但已被改成二战的不同战区。

I hope to continue to do more experimentation with this in the future.

column2: As you probably noticed, the SS units are much larger and as would appear they carry much more punch, in the battle sense.  In this campaign, I gave these Elite SS Divisions a strength of 15.  I started out by giving them a strength of 12, but for the difficulty I have set, this was too low.  I also tried 13, but this was still not enough.  Finally for this campaign, I made them 15 but I may not do this for the next ones I create.  There is another reason I gave them this high a strength value.  From research I discovered that the Waffen SS had machineguns assigned to them down to the squad level, and their weapons platoons at the company level also were loaded with machine guns and mortars.  They also had extensive training in aggression, tactics, and teamwork, while at the same time acquiring high levels of "Esprit De Corps".  They also tended to get priority in new weapons allocation and resupply.  Lastly, these units are what this campaign is all about!
column3: 你可能已经注意到，党卫军单位大得多，从战斗意义上说，它们的打击力也强得多。  在本战役中，我给这些精锐党卫军师设定了 15 的强度。  我最初给它们设定 12 的强度，但就我设定的难度而言，这太低了。  我也试过 13，仍然不够。  最终在本战役中，我把它们设为 15，但在我以后制作的战役中可能不会这么做。  我给它们这么高的强度值还有另一个原因。  通过研究我发现，武装党卫军的机枪一直配备到班一级，他们连一级的武器排也装备了大量机枪和迫击炮。  他们还接受了大量关于进攻、战术和协同的训练，同时也培养出很高的“团队精神”。  他们在新武器分配和补给方面也往往能优先。  最后，这些单位正是本战役的全部内容！

column2: DO NOT OVERSTRENGTH YOUR ELITE UNITS OR THEY WILL INCREMENT UP TO A INCOMPREHENSIBLE NUMBER.  THIS MAY CAUSE PROBLEMS WITH THE CAMPAIGN.
column3: 不要超编强化你的精锐单位，否则它们的数值会递增到一个无法理解的地步。  这可能导致战役出现问题。

column2: I would like to note that by the end of World War II most of the major world powers re-organized and trained their combat units very similarly to the way the Waffen SS units were organized and trained prior to and during the war.
column3: 我想指出，到第二次世界大战结束时，大多数主要世界强国对其战斗单位的改编和训练方式，与武装党卫军单位在战前和战时的组织和训练方式非常相似。

column2: Another feature of this game is that I have designated each unit as a battalion.  In this campaign's Waffen SS units, a panzer division consists of 1 Recon Btn, 2 Tank Btns, 3 Artillery Btns, 6 Infantry Btns, 1 Engineer Btn, 1 Anti-Tank (AT) Btn, 1 Air-Defense (AD) Btn.
column3: 本游戏的另一个特点是，我把每个单位都设定为一个营。  在本战役的武装党卫军单位中，一个装甲师由 1 个侦察营、2 个坦克营、3 个炮兵营、6 个步兵营、1 个工兵营、1 个反坦克(AT)营、1 个防空(AD)营组成。

column2: The scenarios in this campaign start out very tough, and get harder and harder as the campaign goes on.  I gave the artifical intelligence, your  "opponent", the maximum number of units in each scenario.  In WWII, it seemed the SS units always had the most difficult objectives and almost always faced a numerically superior enemy.  This campaign is about SS units against the Allies, they encounter alot of numerical inferiority in each scenario.
column3: 本战役中的场景一开始就非常艰难，而且随着战役推进越来越难。  我给了人工智能，也就是你的“对手”，每个场景中最大的单位数量。  在二战中，党卫军单位似乎总是承担最困难的目标，而且几乎总是面对数量上占优的敌人。  本战役讲的是党卫军单位对抗盟军，他们在每个场景中都会遇到很大的兵力劣势。

column2: I tried to create different scenarios than already had been created.  The Kursk scenario has a tremendous number of built-up Soviet fortifications to it.  I also wanted to give the SS PanzerKorps Commander, (you), the feel for having fortifications, so you get them assigned to you in the Normandy Defense scenario.   Also, I tried to follow history as much as possible, and deviated only when I feel I had to make this campaign as much fun as possible.
column3: 我尝试创作与已有场景不同的场景。  库尔斯克(Kursk)场景有大量构筑好的苏军工事。  我还想让党卫军装甲军指挥官——也就是你——体验拥有工事的感觉，因此在诺曼底(Normandy)防御场景中会把工事分配给你。  另外，我尽可能遵循历史，只有在为了让本战役尽可能有趣而不得不偏离时才偏离。

column2: I created the scenarios from scratch except where I felt that the original games' scenarios couldn't be improved upon, some of them I kept but I just made them harder.
column3: 这些场景都是我重新制作的，只有在我觉得原版游戏的场景无法再改进时才例外；其中一些我保留了下来，只是把它们改得更难。

column2: In the beginning of the campaign you may feel the SS Units are too numerous and too strong.  Don't get too overconfident because later in the campaign you will fight other units every bit as strong as your own.  Gather as much experience for your units as possible, they will need it later on in the campaign.  Also, don't let your elite SS units get destroyed, once they are gone you won't get them back.  You will have to replace them with others that may not be as good.
column3: 在战役开始时，你可能会觉得党卫军单位数量太多、也太强。  不要过于自信，因为战役后期你会与和你自己一样强的其他单位作战。  尽可能为你的单位积累经验，战役后期会需要这些经验。  另外，不要让精锐的党卫军单位被消灭，一旦没了就再也拿不回来了。  你只能用其他可能没那么好的单位来替换它们。
